name: Craft Addons for WPBakery Page Builder
author: jques

sections.description:
Best Elements and Feature Addon Plugin for WPBakery

Craft Addons for WPBakery is a lightweight pack of custom content elements for the WPBakery Page Builder (formerly Visual Composer). It adds the building blocks most websites actually need – an icon box, an animated counter, testimonials, a team member card, a client logo grid, a flip card and more – all designed to look polished the moment you drop them on the page.

Craft Addons Pro ⭐ | Elements | Features | Contact Us

These are elements we build and use on real client projects, so they ship with sensible defaults and only the styling controls you actually reach for. No oversized option panels to wade through, no setup wizard to sit through. Add an element, adjust a few settings, and carry on building your page.

Why Craft Addons

  • Zero setup. Every element looks great out of the box and matches your theme without custom CSS.
  • Fast by design. Each element loads its own CSS and JavaScript only on the pages where it is actually used, so the plugin never weighs down the rest of your site.
  • Feels native. Elements live in their own category in the WPBakery library and use the same editing experience you already know. Works in the backend editor and the WPBakery frontend (inline) editor.
  • Tidy editor. Turn any element or feature on or off from the Craft Addons dashboard, so the builder only shows what you use.
  • Translation ready. All strings are translatable through the craft-addons-for-wpbakery text domain.

Free Elements

  • Icon Box. An icon or image paired with a heading, text and an optional link or button. Ideal for feature grids, service lists and “why choose us” sections.
  • Counter. A number that animates upward as it scrolls into view, with an optional prefix, suffix and label – perfect for stats like clients served or projects shipped.
  • Single Testimonial. A customer quote with an avatar, name, role and star rating to build trust on landing and sales pages.
  • Flip Container. A 3D flip card with a front and a back. Place any WPBakery content on each side and it flips on hover or on click.
  • Info List. A repeatable list of icon + title + description rows – the classic feature list, benefit list or “what’s included” block.
  • Logo Grid. A responsive grid of client or partner logos, with hover opacity, optional links and alt text for each logo.
  • Team Member. A photo, name, role and social links in several ready-made layouts – great for about and team pages.
  • Interactive Banner. A promo banner with image, overlay text and hover effects – perfect for eye-catching calls to action.

Free Features

Optional modules that add capabilities across every element. Turn them on or off from the dashboard.

  • Responsive Visibility. Hide any element on the screen sizes you choose (desktop, tablet, mobile).
  • Dynamic Content. Insert live post data and custom fields straight into your elements.

Craft Addons Pro

Upgrade to Pro to unlock advanced elements and features, priority updates and friendly support.

Pro Elements

  • Image Scroller. A tall screenshot that scrolls on hover or follows the cursor – perfect for showing off a full web page or an app screen inside a compact frame.
  • Before / After. Compare two images with a draggable divider – ideal for retouching, renovation and product comparisons.
  • Query Grid. Query any content – posts, products or custom post types – and lay it out as a polished card grid.

Pro Features

  • Scroll Animations. Animate any element as it scrolls into view for a modern, lively page.

See everything Pro adds on the Craft Addons website.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the WPBakery Page Builder plugin.
  2. Upload the craft-addons-for-wpbakery folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen in your dashboard.
  3. Activate Craft Addons for WPBakery.
  4. Edit any page with WPBakery and look for the new elements in the “Craft Addons” category.
sections.faq:
Do I need WPBakery Page Builder to use this?

Yes. Craft Addons adds elements to the WPBakery Page Builder, so WPBakery needs to be installed and active. The plugin does nothing on its own.

Does it work with Visual Composer?

WPBakery Page Builder is the current name for the plugin that used to be called Visual Composer, so yes, you are in the right place.

Will it slow down my website?

No. Each element only loads its own CSS and JavaScript, and only on the pages where you actually place that element. Pages without Craft Addons elements load nothing extra.

Can I turn off the elements I do not use?

Yes. The Craft Addons dashboard lets you enable or disable each element and feature individually, so the editor stays tidy.

Will the elements match my theme?

In most cases, yes. Each element exposes the styling that matters for it – colors, sizes, spacing and typography – so you can line it up with your theme’s look without custom CSS.

Does it work with the WPBakery frontend editor?

Yes. The elements work in both the backend editor and the WPBakery frontend (inline) editor.

What do I get with Craft Addons Pro?

Pro unlocks advanced elements (Image Scroller, Before / After and Query Grid), the Scroll Animations feature, priority updates and support. See the pricing page for details.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. All text is translatable through the craft-addons-for-wpbakery text domain.
